as_told.title: Lockheed and TRW crates in Close Encounters as crash retrieval hints

plain: Steven Spielberg's 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind shows shipping crates marked TRW and Skunk Works, two aerospace research outfits (Skunk Works is the secret design unit of the aircraft maker Lockheed), at a time when few people knew much about either. Michels brings this up in three episodes. In the latest he names the companies as Lockheed and TRW and calls them "two likely active legacy UFO crash retrieval programs", meaning secret efforts to recover and keep crashed craft. If he is right, Spielberg was quietly pointing at who really held the wreckage.
